name: Linkin Park

whyMatters.en: Agoura Hills six-piece that made rap-rock/nu-metal the default millennial rock radio format via Hybrid Theory (2000) and Meteora (2003).
whyMatters.zh: 阿古拉山六人组：借 Hybrid Theory（2000）与 Meteora（2003）把 rap-rock/nu-metal 做成千禧一代摇滚电台默认格式。

lyricQuotes: I tried so hard and got so far / But in the end it doesn't even matter
I've become so numb / I can't feel you there

shortBio.en: Bennington / Shinoda dual-vocal nu-metal; Hybrid Theory is the 2000 radio template.
shortBio.zh: Bennington / Shinoda 双人声 nu-metal；Hybrid Theory 是 2000 电台模板。

body.en:
Formed 1996 as Xero in Agoura Hills. Hybrid Theory and Meteora fuse DJ/sample beds, downtuned guitars, Shinoda's rap verses, Bennington's melodic chorus.

In the End (2000) is the structural template for a decade of bands. Later catalogs add electronic and concept turns; chronicle weight is how 2000–03 rock radio sounded in malls and on MTV.
body.zh:
1996 年于阿古拉山以 Xero 组建。Hybrid Theory 与 Meteora 融合 DJ/采样铺底、降调吉他、Shinoda rap 主歌、Bennington 旋律副歌。

In the End（2000）是整整十年乐队的结构模板。后期目录加入电子与概念转向；编年分量是 2000–03 商场与 MTV 上的摇滚电台声景。

note.en: Hybrid Theory debut; DJ scratches and downtuned chug on rock radio.
note.zh: Hybrid Theory 首波；DJ 刮碟与降调 chug 上摇滚电台。

note.en: Piano loop plus rap verse and melodic chorus; mall-rock template.
note.zh: 钢琴 loop 加 rap 主歌与旋律副歌；商场摇滚模板。

note.en: Meteora; sustained notes and dual-vocal stack on MTV.
note.zh: Meteora；延音与双人声堆叠上 MTV。

title.en: Rap verse, sung chorus, DJ bed
title.zh: Rap 主歌、唱副歌、DJ 铺底

body.en:
Hybrid Theory (2000) sells 10M+ US with a fixed formula: Shinoda rap verse, Bennington melodic hook, Hahn's scratches, Delson's detuned power chords.

In the End and Crawling share one cycle—proof that nu-metal can lead with piano and melody, not only chug.
body.zh:
Hybrid Theory（2000）以固定公式卖过千万：Shinoda rap 主歌、Bennington 旋律 hook、Hahn 刮碟、Delson 降调 power chord。

In the End 与 Crawling 同属一周期——证明 nu-metal 可以钢琴与旋律先行，不只 chug。

body.en:
Bennington joins 1999; the six—Bennington, Shinoda, Delson, Bourdon, Farrell, Hahn—record Hybrid Theory and Meteora. Shinoda is writer/producer hub; Hahn is the explicit DJ chair.

Post-2017 lineup changes follow Bennington's death; catalog peak remains the 2000–03 six-piece.
body.zh:
Bennington 1999 加入；六人——Bennington、Shinoda、Delson、Bourdon、Farrell、Hahn——录 Hybrid Theory 与 Meteora。Shinoda 是写作/制作枢纽；Hahn 是明确 DJ 席。

2017 后阵容随 Bennington 离世变动；目录峰值仍是 2000–03 六人组。

title.zh: 千禧一代摇滚电台默认

body.en:
Rage Against the Machine supplies the rap-over-riff idea; Deftones and NIN supply texture; Evanescence shares the dual-vocal goth-adjacent slot on 2000s charts.

Influence is structural—verse/chorus/DJ layout copied across 2000s alt-metal more than any single riff.
body.zh:
Rage Against the Machine 提供 riff 上 rap 概念；Deftones 与 NIN 提供纹理；Evanescence 在 2000 年代榜单共享双人声近 goth 槽位。

影响在结构——2000 年代 alt-metal 多抄主歌/副歌/DJ 布局，少抄单一 riff。
